correctness.rationale: PASS: The eight specified halfspaces are genuine Voronoi bisectors and the other four bound a signed-permutation chamber. Independent rational reconstruction found 455 invertible intersections among 792 five-hyperplane choices, precisely 41 feasible vertices and four candidates maximizing q=27/50. A provably sufficient bounding box for site displacements (first four <1, fifth <3/2) yields precisely six equidistant nearest sites for each, all with absolute coordinate determinant 1. The 384-element site stabilizer produces three disjoint 192-hole orbits, linked by site-changing symmetries into one global orbit. Double-count 2 sites per D5 period times 576 holes per site divided by six sites per hole =192. Delaunay cells are interior-disjoint; 192 simplices of determinant 1 occupy fraction 192/(120*2)=4/5. The bounded certificate is mathematically exhaustive because of chamber containment and site-distance cutoff, not because of floating-point optimization.
